t=df['t'].values; x=df['x'].values; v=df['v'].values; y=df['dv_dt'].values
def lib_for(k):
    Tf={'1':np.ones_like(t),'t':t,'t2':t*t}
    for w in np.linspace(0.05,3,60):
        Tf['cos%.3f'%w]=np.cos(w*t); Tf['sin%.3f'%w]=np.sin(w*t); Tf['exp%.3f'%w]=np.exp(-w*t)
    Xf={'1':np.ones_like(x),'x':x,'x2':x*x,'x3':x**3,'1/x':1/x,'sqrtx':np.sqrt(x),'exp-x':np.exp(-x),'x/(1+x)':x/(1+x),'x/(1+kx)':x/(1+k*x),'1/(1+x)':1/(1+x),'sinx':np.sin(x),'cosx':np.cos(x)}
    Vf={'1':np.ones_like(v),'v':v,'v2':v*v,'v3':v**3,'sqrtv':np.sqrt(v),'1/v':1/v,'exp-v':np.exp(-v),'sinv':np.sin(v),'cosv':np.cos(v),'v1.5':v**1.5,'tanh v':np.tanh(v),'1/(1+v)':1/(1+v)}
    L={}
    for a,fa in Tf.items(): L['T'+a]=fa
    for a,fa in Xf.items(): L['X'+a]=fa
    for a,fa in Vf.items(): L['V'+a]=fa
    for a,fa in Tf.items():
        for b,gb in Xf.items(): L['T%s*X%s'%(a,b)]=fa*gb
        for b,gb in Vf.items(): L['T%s*V%s'%(a,b)]=fa*gb
    for a,fa in Xf.items():
        for b,gb in Vf.items(): L['X%s*V%s'%(a,b)]=fa*gb
    return L
def run(k, top=1):
    L=lib_for(k)
    names=[n for n in L if np.std(L[n])>1e-10]
    M=np.column_stack([L[n] for n in names])
    kn=x/(1+k*x)*np.sqrt(v)
    best=[]
    # orthogonal projection onto complement of kn and constant
    A0=np.column_stack([kn]); 
    Pn=M-A0@np.linalg.lstsq(A0,M,rcond=None)[0]
    yr=y-A0@np.linalg.lstsq(A0,y,rcond=None)[0]
    cor=np.abs(Pn.T@yr)/(np.linalg.norm(Pn,axis=0)+1e-12)
    idx=np.argsort(-cor)[:top]
    for i in idx:
        A=np.column_stack([kn,M[:,i]])
        # exhaustive second term
        out=[]
        for j in range(M.shape[1]):
            if j==i: continue
            B=np.column_stack([A,M[:,j]])
            c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(B,y,rcond=None)
            rr=y-B@c
            out.append((np.mean(rr**2)/np.var(y), names[i], names[j]))
        best+=sorted(out)[:2]
    return best
